acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an open-concept kitchen remodel in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex can vary widely, influenced by factors such as the extent of structural changes, the size of the kitchen, and your chosen finishes. Substantial renovations involving wall removal, custom cabinetry, high-end countertops, and integrated smart-home features will naturally be a greater investment. AKN Design Group provides upfront, detailed estimates based on our comprehensive design and scope development.
